title: Public Pi fixture — recorded model-price cost baseline

source.extractedFields: Identity, ordinal, timestamps, model/provider/API, stop reason, token usage and recorded cost only. No prompts, responses, tool arguments/results, paths from conversation or compaction summaries.

money.interpretation: Recorded usage.cost values preserved; not repriced at current rates and not an invoice or verified billable charge. Currency inferred from upstream documented USD convention; fixture has no explicit currency field.

widthPolicy.rounding: ROUND_HALF_EVEN independently per observation after exact decimal multiplication by 1000000000
widthPolicy.aggregation: Sum assigned integer observation widths; never independently round parent totals or sum parent and child costs.
widthPolicy.unknownCosts: null; excluded from numeric width, disclosed as unknown rather than converted to zero
widthPolicy.zeroCosts: Native zero preserved as zero width; not evidence of a free provider attempt.
widthPolicy.safeIntegerCheck: Every assigned width and their total are below Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.

coverage.identityKind: fixture SHA-256 plus physical source line, not provider identity
coverage.deduplication: One observation per assistant source line. No provider-response deduplication possible; replay identity stable only for this exact fixture.
knownUnknowns: Two compactions have no usage or cost; their cost is unknown and absent from numeric widths.
Thirteen aborted/error records report zero tokens and zero cost; no provider evidence proves these attempts incurred no charge.
Nonzero aborted assistant costs are retained as recorded partial observations.
No provider response IDs, runtime version, price snapshot, invoice, or settlement provenance is recorded.
Record identity prevents duplicate import of this exact evidence, but cannot prove distinct records represent distinct billable provider responses.
The observed total is not a certified complete task cost.
coverage.syntheticHierarchy: Any workstream, ticket, epic, or business grouping is analyst-supplied unless backed by separate evidence. compactionSegment is only an observed transcript-boundary index.
